title: cfDNA Scale Tradeoff Audit: reproducible analysis of normalization scale and cross-study score transport
description: Reproducible software and compact statistical outputs accompanying the Scale Trade-offs in Within-Sample Self-Normalization audit of public cfDNA cohorts. Includes source-isolated preprocessing, global/local/Hybrid comparisons, pair concordance decomposition, fixed real-patient composition stress tests, automated tests and checksum-verifiable provenance. Original software is MIT licensed; third-party data and reference annotations retain their original terms.
